Design: compact-chrome-r2.html (built by build.py from src/; spec at ?v=spec). Round 1 stays as compact-chrome-r1.html; its sources, check and decisions are in r1-src/, its shots in shots-r1/, its result in check-result-r1.txt. Shots: shots-r2/ (26 states × 390×664, 844×340, 932×380 × light and dark, 9 states at 320×568, plus 1440 against the approved page). Check: check.mjs → check-result.txt, run on mbp2606 through ../tick-2606.sh.

Frame: the approved Agents page (AEON-1196 r7, ~/.aeon/lead/aeon/design/ag-approved/). Session panel and chat: AEON-1264 r2 + A1 (../sv/approved-candidate/). Live code read at origin/main 3507e3319: App.vue, AppHeader.vue, AppFooter.vue, SessionList.vue, SessionsHeld.vue, AgentsView.vue, ProjectView.vue, ListToolbar.vue, TicketTable.vue, SessionPanel.vue, SessionChat.vue, footerSummary.ts, modelsSimple.ts.

Boundary (Tick, 07:3x): Expert's layouts (Panel · Focus · Full screen) and the terminal box are AEON-1264 r3 (../sv/amend-a2-terminal-size-layout.md). This round designs the phone head, tabs, Session tab and Chat; Expert is one shot only.

TL;DR:

  • One rule: compact = (max-width: 719px), (max-height: 500px).
  • Header: 44 px, opaque.
  • Toolbar: one opaque 44 px line, Title · status · Search · Filter · ⋯.
  • Removed: the column head, and the footer bar.
  • Moved: the footer's summary goes into the toolbar's status slot, and its release into the avatar menu.
  • Held changes: a floating chip.
  • Landscape: only the toolbar sticks. Chrome while reading is 44 px, with 5 rows at 844 and 6 at 932.
  • Portrait: 88 px of chrome and 9 rows.
  • Chat: 66–69 % thread in landscape.
  • Round 2:
  • The Agents top is folded: the Sessions toolbar starts at 159 px at 390 and 101 px in landscape.
  • The panel head is A4 (← · avatar · two lines · ⋯; every action in ⋯), with A3's flat menu.
  • Toolbars are opaque everywhere.
  • "+" is a reference picker.
  • The composer is checked at 320.
  • Desktop 1440: identical to approved r7.

Answers to the round 1 questions (Tick, delegated)

  • The header scrolls away in short landscape: yes. D7 stands.
  • No footer bar in portrait: yes. D5 stands: the summary goes to the toolbar, and the release name and time to the avatar menu.
  • The status slot: it shows the page counts' state icon (▶, green play) and the number, with the aria-label "12 working". The bare dot is gone. Landscape adds the word "working". D3 is updated.
  • Chat "+": it ships with the one thing that works, a ticket or session reference. "+" opens a small picker (search + recent tickets and sessions) that inserts a reference.
  • It never shows a dead item.
  • Uploads join when a contract exists.
  • D10 is updated.
  • The desktop toolbar: opaque at every width now (--surface-raised, no blur), the Sessions toolbar and the ticket toolbar alike (AIT-155).
  • 1440's geometry is unchanged and still identical to approved r7.
  • The pixel check runs at 1440 too.
  • Landscape with the keyboard up (98 px of thread): accepted for now (typing in landscape is rare). Noted in the spec.

Decisions (with reasons; where I differ from Tick's lean, it says so)

D1 · One compact rule, height-aware

  • The rule: compact chrome applies at (max-width: 719px), (max-height: 500px).
  • Short landscape is (max-height: 500px) and (min-width: 720px). It gets its own list form (D6) and the sheet's one-line head (D9).
  • Why 719, not 600:
  • 719 matches the session sheet's phone breakpoint (r2) and AgentsView's phone rule (720).
  • One rule for all chrome means the header, the toolbar and the sheet never disagree at 601–719.
  • The live AppHeader and AppFooter phone rules (600) move to the shared rule.
  • Why height-aware: landscape phones are 844–932 wide but only 340–380 high (Tick). A short desktop window (1440×480) also gets the compact chrome. That is intended.

D2 · Header: 44 px, opaque, nothing wraps (Tick's lean, plus three calls)

  • Contents: the places as 44 px round icons (Projects · Agents · [Business] · Decision Desk with its count), the crumb (D11), search as an icon (it opens the command palette), settings (AppMenu), and the avatar.
  • Opaque: --chrome: var(--surface-raised), no blur. The pixel check passes.
  • The brand mark:
  • Landscape shows the mark only, with no "PPM" word.
  • Portrait drops the mark, as AppHeader does on phones today: Projects is home.
  • Reason: at 390 the crumb needs the room. Places 3×44 + search, settings and avatar 3×44 + the crumb come to about 380 px.
  • Theme toggle: in the avatar menu on every width (Tick's lean). The live moon button goes.
  • Decision Desk preview chevron: removed on compact. The Desk is one tap. The preview is a desktop affordance and costs 44 px.
  • Business: hidden in portrait (as today), shown in landscape.
  • Safe areas: the header is edge to edge. Its content is padded by max(4px, safe-area-inset-left/right). The mock simulates 47 px at 844 and 59 px at 932.

D3 · The Sessions toolbar: one 44 px line, opaque (Tick's lean, with the footer's status added; R2: ▶ icon, opaque everywhere)

  • Line: Sessions 18 · grow · status slot (● 12 working, ● 12 in portrait) · Search · Filter · ⋯.
  • Filter: stays an icon.
  • Applied filters show as the icon in teal plus a count badge.
  • The pills row under the head is not shown on compact (it would be a second line).
  • Clear all lives in the Filter sheet.
  • ⋯ holds: Display… (group, sort), Collapse all / Expand all, Clear stale, History.
  • Search opens over the toolbar line as an overlay of the same box (search field + Cancel). Nothing moves (checked).
  • The field is 44 px. The toolbar colour forms a 5 px inset, so the pill reads 34 px.
  • The text is 16 px, so iOS does not zoom.
  • The field stays open while a query is set. Cancel clears it.
  • Opaque: a solid --chrome, no blur, no 94 % mix. This fixes "rows show behind Sessions 287" (pixel check: identical with rows hidden or shown).
  • The status slot is the footer's centre (footerSummary, short form: dot plus count). It moved here because the footer bar is gone (D5). It is role=status, and its words are in its aria-label.
  • Under 380 px it steps aside.
  • Differs from Tick: Tick put it in the landscape toolbar only. I put it in portrait too, because portrait loses the footer as well.

D4 · Held changes: never a toolbar line (Tick's lean)

  • Touch never holds. That is the scroll-fix build (aeon-1279-scrollfix).
  • Where it can still appear on a compact screen (a short desktop window, or an iPad with a trackpad): a floating button over the list's foot, like Jump to live. It shows the hold icon, "2 changes wait" and "Show now".
  • It is an overlay (position: fixed). The toolbar stays 44 px (checked).
  • Desktop 1440 keeps the approved note in the head, unchanged.

D5 · No footer bar on compact, in portrait too (differs from Tick for portrait)

  • Short landscape: no footer bar (Tick's lean).
  • Portrait: no footer bar either, not even an overlay that slides away.
  • Evidence:
  • A 44 px footer on top of a 44 + 44 header and toolbar is 132 px. That breaks the 120 px portrait budget whenever it shows.
  • An overlay that slides in and out on scroll direction is motion under the thumb. It still covers the last row when shown.
  • Safari's own bottom toolbar already sits there in portrait.
  • The live auto-hide is the H2 bug (it resized main mid-scroll).
  • Where its parts go:
  • The summary goes to the toolbar's status slot (D3). The ticket list shows its count there in landscape and at the list's end in portrait.
  • The release (name · calendar version) goes to the avatar menu: "What's new · Myriad Maser · 26·10·12 21:15", which opens the release history.
  • The wordmark goes to the avatar menu's foot line, "PAIMOS AEON".
  • The result: the scroll container never changes size on phones (constant, as the diagnosis asks).

D6 · The column head: none on phones and short screens (evidence)

  • Portrait: rows are compact (two lines, the time at the line end). There is no column head, as today.
  • Short landscape: no column head either.
  • Evidence:
  • Header 44 + toolbar 44 + a 24 px head is 112 px, over the 96 px budget.
  • Each value reads on its own: the time ("1 h 33 min", with a tip) and the model with its harness mark ("Opus 5.5 · max").
  • Computer and Beat drop to the panel's Details. A missing heartbeat already shows as the avatar's state ("No heartbeat") and in line 2.
  • Sorting by column moves to ⋯ › Display › Sort.
  • The short table:
  • Columns: Session · Time · Execution (model only, no account line) · ⋯.
  • Rows are 48 px: two lines, 20 + 17 px. The ⋯ target is 44 px.

D7 · Short landscape: only the list's toolbar sticks; the app header scrolls away (beyond Tick's lean, evidence)

  • With a sticky header, chrome is 88 px (within 96). But at 844×340 the list gets 252 px. With 48 px rows that is 5 fully visible at an aligned scroll and 4 at the worst offset (measured: 4/4/5/4).
  • 5 at every offset needs rows of 42 px or less. That is below the 44 px target.
  • With the header in the page's flow on short screens:
  • Chrome while reading is 44 px.
  • Rows: 5 at 844 at every offset (5/5/6/5), and 6 at 932 (6/6/6/6). The ticket list gets 5 and 6.
  • The header is back at the top (one swipe, or a tap on the status bar).
  • Build note: App.vue drops the header grid row on short screens and renders AppHeader as main's first child (static). The scroll container never resizes; it is no hide-on-scroll trick.
  • Portrait keeps the sticky header. There is room: 88 px, 9 rows.

D8 · The Agents page head on compact

  • Portrait: the approved r7 phone head, unchanged:
  • title and actions on line 1, counts on line 2;
  • the capacity row as approved.
  • Short landscape: one 44 px line: Agents (22 px) · the counts with their words · Wind down (icon) · ⋯ · New. The capacity row also fits on one line.
  • Both are page content. They scroll away before the toolbar sticks.

D9 · The session panel on phones (round 1; R2.2 replaces the head and the tabs with A4 + A3)

  • Portrait: r2's sheet is unchanged in its head and tabs:
  • back · avatar · name over the state word · Interrupt · ⋯ (Pause and Stop… are in ⋯);
  • the 44 px tab line.
  • Short landscape: the tabs join the head's line, which saves 44 px:
  • back · avatar · name over state · Session Chat Expert · grow · Interrupt · ⋯;
  • the whole line is 44 px;
  • the selected tab is a tint inset in its 44 px target.
  • The sheet:
  • It is full screen inside the safe areas on short screens too. Today a non-phone sheet is an inset card between the header and the footer.
  • It follows the visual viewport (--vv-h, already in SessionPanel).
  • Session tab, compact:
  • Visible facts: Computer, Model, Ticket, Chat and Control.
  • Behind "More details": Account, Harness and Heartbeat. The same button also leads to provenance and runs.
  • Lead tab: the first 4 workers, then "Show all N workers".
  • The folds are per visit.
  • Expert: r3 (A2) owns its Panel · Focus · Full screen layouts and the terminal box. Here it is one shot only (expert), in the compact sheet. On phones A2's Full screen is the way to the most room.

D10 · Chat on phones: the thread first

  • The composer is in flow under the thread. It never covers the last message (checked: the composer's top is at or below the thread's bottom).
  • It ends at the visual viewport's foot, including with the keyboard up (checked with ?kb=1).
  • Attach goes behind "+", at the composer's start: Photo or screenshot · File · Ticket or session.
  • Open: the live chat has no attachments today. See Q4.
  • Queued messages become a count: r2's queued-message strip becomes a "1 queued" control in the composer on phones. It opens the same items with Edit and Cancel.
  • Desktop keeps r2's strip.
  • The strip was 52 px. It cost the thread a fifth of the landscape height.
  • Portrait: two lines, 113 px: + · message (44 px, grows to 120), then 1 queued · Send now · After this turn. r2's labels stay.
  • Short landscape: one line, 72 px: + · message · 1 queued · Send now · After this turn.
  • Thread share: 66 % at 844 and 69 % at 932 (target 60 %).
  • Keyboard up:
  • Portrait hides the tab line. The head stays (back, Interrupt).
  • Landscape hides the head line. With 170 px left, the thread keeps what is left.
  • Delivery states follow r2 unchanged: under each bubble, and Not delivered with Retry.

D11 · The ticket list on phones (Tick's lean, with Filter kept visible)

  • Header crumb: / AEON ▾ in portrait, / AEON Paimos Aeon ▾ in landscape.
  • It opens the project's sheet: title, description, progress and counts; the sections Tickets · Knowledge · Delivery · Settings; and the lead.
  • The project head on the page is removed on compact. It was 150–250 px.
  • Toolbar, one 44 px line: the view control (icon + saved view name ▾) · grow · [count, landscape only] · Search · Filter · New (+) · ⋯.
  • The view control opens the saved views (My open · All open · In QA · Recently done), the layout (List · Outline · Graph) and Needs attention.
  • ⋯ holds Display… (group by, sort, columns, row height), Hide done, Select tickets (bulk), Save view as…, Copy link and Export CSV.
  • Differs from Tick: Filter stays visible, as on the Agents toolbar. Narrowing a long list is a primary phone task, and the two toolbars then read the same.
  • Rows:
  • Portrait, 56 px: status icon · title (one line) on line 1, KEY · when on line 2 · the assignee (24 px) at the end.
  • Landscape, 44 px, one line: status · key · title · assignee · when.
  • Priority, labels and estimate are dropped from the phone row; they are in the ticket. The row's status menu is dropped; the status changes in the ticket.
  • The whole row opens the ticket.

D12 · Model names

  • Every name goes through fullName(): "Opus 5.5", "Sonnet 5", "GPT-6.1 Sol", per the A1 note.

Open questions (round 1; answered by Tick above, see "Answers")

  • Q1 (Tick): D7 lets the header scroll away on short screens. It is the only way to 5 fully visible rows at every offset at 844 with 44 px targets. The alternative is a sticky header with 88 px chrome and 4–5 rows. OK?
  • Q2 (Tick): D5 removes the footer bar in portrait too, instead of the slide-away overlay. OK?
  • Q3 (Tick): in portrait the status slot reads "● 12" (the words "12 working" are in its aria-label and tip). Clear enough, or drop it in portrait?
  • Q4 (LEAD): chat attachments do not exist in the live API; SessionChat has none. Should P2 ship "+" with only "Ticket or session" (a reference), or hide it until an upload contract exists?
  • Q5 (Tick): the desktop toolbar is still 94 % see-through (approved r7, unchanged by the brief). Make it opaque everywhere?
  • Q6 (LEAD): chat with the keyboard up in landscape leaves 98 px of thread at 844. That is iOS's reality. The head hides then. Enough?

GUI-27, item by item (checked in every state × size × theme by check.mjs, plus by eye on the shots)

  • Edge accents: none.
  • The scan finds no one-sided border of 2 px or more and no inset bar.
  • Selection is a tint inset in its target: the active place, the selected tab in the landscape head.
  • Pills: none new.
  • Status is a dot and a number ("● 12 working"), not a pill.
  • The held chip and Jump to live are floating buttons.
  • The count badges on Filter and the Desk are counts on an icon.
  • Chips for status: none.
  • Boxes around everything: no new boxes.
  • The toolbars are lines.
  • Menus and sheets are the existing popover.
  • The approved r7 parts (capacity row, Lead facts) are unchanged.
  • Eyebrows everywhere: only as section labels inside the Filter sheet (State · Project · Harness) and the view menu (Saved views · Layout). That is the approved FilterMenu and DisplayPanel pattern; there are none on the page.
  • Italics: none (scanned).
  • Mixed languages: English only.
